rationale: C10 is the strongest plausible drafting template because it uses the same single-dispute structure for a named lead railroad plus other carriers represented by a conference committee, incorporates an attached List A with the distinctive phrase “attached hereto and hereby made a part hereof,” identifies one labor organization, and repeats the same section 10 status-quo machinery. The child adapts that concrete framework from one regional committee to the Eastern, Western, and Southeastern committees and substitutes the Railroad Yardmasters and a new carrier list. C17 is especially relevant because it concerns the same union and the same three conference committees, but it lacks the child’s attached-list machinery. C21 has that tripartite committee-and-list structure but is less textually close and treats plural disputes.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the Baltimore and Ohio Railroad Company and other carriers represented by the Eastern, Western, and Southeastern Carriers' Conference Committees, designated in List A attached hereto and hereby made a part hereof
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the Chicago, Rock Island and Pacific Railroad Company and other carriers represented by the Western Carriers' Conference Committee, designated in List A attached hereto and hereby made a part hereof
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive parallel formulation naming a lead railroad, additional conference-represented carriers, and an incorporated carrier list.

shared_material.child_excerpt: certain of their employees represented by the Railroad Yardmasters of America, a labor organization
shared_material.parent_excerpt: certain of their employees represented by the Switchmen's Union of North America, AFL-CIO, a labor organization
shared_material.explanation: The same grammatical slot and operative structure are retained while the represented employee organization is changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made
shared_material.explanation: The later directive reproduces the central legal machinery verbatim and adapts only the regulated carriers and employees.
